DIAGNOSIS READY: Pseudomyxoma Peritonei secondary to a mucinous ovarian tumor (likely of appendiceal origin).

The clinical picture of a rapidly enlarging abdominal girth, shortness of breath, and an ovarian mass in a 40-year-old woman is highly suggestive of a mucinous neoplasm causing pseudomyxoma peritonei. Given the acute one-month progression, immediate imaging is required to assess the extent of peritoneal seeding and ascites.
